name: (Melfesh Monster) Vent Flames

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Monsters of Myth

text:
Trigger The Melfesh Monster ends its movement next to or takes damage from an adjacent creature

---

Effect Rifts in the Melfesh Monster's body spew burning gas. The triggering creature must succeed at a DC 21 Reflex save save or inhale spores which remain in its body for 1 minute, take 2d6 fire damage, and become Sickened 1 (on a critical failure, double damage and Sickened 2). This ability replaces Reactive Growth.
